about: The library graph of PrompTugal.news in the explorer's own shape (the same as api/v1/graph/explorer.json, so /assets/graph/explorer.js draws it unchanged). nodes[i]: {id, type, label, page?, src (index into sources, -1 for none), kind (the call class and subclass), by (the maker), status, category (the first subject), date, what, call, deg, bc (betweenness x1000), pr (PageRank x1000), x, y (a force layout)}. edges[j]: [from node index, to node index, verb index, source index or -1, read date or 0, edge betweenness]. Each connection is stored once, in the direction the card asserts it; the explorer reads it either way with the verb and its inverse. types[] may carry shape and color (the explorer draws each type with them) and presets[] is the graph's own list of named views, in the shape of PRESETS in assets/graph/engine.js (the explorer opens on the first). The nodes are the library's cards, grouped to stay legible: 45 collections (one per call class and subclass), the agents, the subjects, every pass, finding, idea, question, desk, decision and article, and the board files and pages with the most connections; the other 1892 cards (the entity pages among them) are not single nodes: a connection to one ends at its collection. Owner edges (owned_by) are read from the owner field of an idea. Generated by library.mjs 0.2.0 from the cards and their typed links; never edited by hand.
